retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered group portrait set within a dense, atmospheric fog with high-contrast display typography featuring internal inline detailing.

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of four men in formal suits positioned at varying depths within a thick, swirling blue-teal fog. The foreground figure is sharpest, while others recede into the mist. Large, stylized sans-serif text with multi-colored inline strokes dominates the left side, accompanied by a vertical list of secondary text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject depth correlated with atmospheric opacity
Large display type anchored to the left third
Cool-toned background contrasting with warm skin tones
Vertical alignment of tracklist text under the main title
coreInvariants: Dense fog obscuring the lower legs of all subjects
High-contrast formal attire (dark suits, white shirts)
Three-color inline treatment on the primary display font

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a diagonal recession from center-left to top-right; foreground subject is approximately half-height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large 'FOUR TOPS' display text on the left acts as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bold title down the tracklist, then sweep right through the receding figures into the fog.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of 'active' negative space filled with textured fog and mist.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and charcoal of the formal suits
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow and purple-pink in the typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background fog with high value contrast in the subjects' clothing.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the outer skeleton
Tight letter spacing with slight overlap in display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'W' has a sharp central vertex

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the fog, left of the main subject

treatment.fill: yellow with purple and blue inlines

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, multi-colored display face paired with a clean, functional sans-serif for information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric skeleton and bold presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of four men in black suits and bowties, arranged in a receding diagonal line from center to top right. The entire scene is engulfed in a thick, swirling teal and blue fog that obscures their legs and creates a misty, ethereal atmosphere.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large geometric sans-serif text in the upper left. The text should have a yellow fill with purple and blue internal inline stripes. Below it, add a vertical list of text in a clean white sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the fog thick enough to obscure the lower third of the subjects?
Does the display text have the multi-colored inline effect?
Is the hierarchy clearly established between the title and the list?

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp typography against soft background

postGenerationChecks: Check for legibility of white text against light fog
Ensure inline stripes follow the curves of the letters
Verify depth of field (foreground sharp, background soft)
recipe.reuseFormula: Atmospheric Fog + Multi-Plane Portrait + Inline Geometric Typography
